verdict.rationale: npm has a registry HTTP API, so a machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask of it, and the axis applies. The only API documentation in the pack is a prose markdown file (REGISTRY-API.md) describing endpoints and search qualifiers, which is not an OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.npmjs.com returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
